mapping_rules.source: Unique committed as-of hub/link maps per namespace/type, never deleted-filtered GC dimensions
mapping_rules.ambiguous_or_missing_map: Report integrity failure, no null fallback/drop/dedupe/winner/many-to-many rescue
mapping_rules.all_physical_hash_columns: Explicit namespace/type bijection and FK/line identity checks; no suffix-based comparator exclusion
fact_consistency: return_hk versus physical return_key for returns
mapping_rules.derived_nullability_provenance: FK and hub-key declarations only; not observed mapping integrity

history_alignment.representation: Natural grain plus attribute_version plus logical_event_delivery
history_alignment.physical_identity: Retain (hk,valid_from), actual timestamps, valid_to, is_current and row multiplicity
history_alignment.event_identity_source: Committed event lineage, not deduped attribute hash
history_alignment.a_b_a: Keep three events even when first and third business values match

schema_pairing.pairing_validation: Fabric-session local declaration consistency check, not independent DB validation or stored-schema pass

calendar_locale: UNVERIFIED; exact month/day text, no normalization
